invariants.statement: Exactly one connected foreground object is present in the image.
invariants.evidence: All 8 reference images display a single, isolated liver cross-section against a black background.

invariants.statement: The image consists strictly of black background and white/grey foreground pixels.

invariants.statement: The foreground object exhibits a uniform, fine-grained speckled texture throughout.
